stem.text: An electric motor operating a lift has an output power of $20\,\text{kW}$.

stem.alt: Electric motor at the top, with a cable running down to a lift box labelled lift and passengers, 1500 kg; a dimension arrow marks 20 m between the top and bottom of the lift's travel

stem.text: The lift and passengers have a combined mass of $1500\,\text{kg}$. The motor raises the lift through a distance of $20\,\text{m}$.
